name: GitHub Copilot Business

price.note: Per seat. Card and PayPal sign-ups charge seats upfront, with no prorated refund when a seat is removed.

meters.label: AI Credits
meters.hint: 1,900 credits ($19) per seat, pooled across the organization. Your Copilot settings page shows your share if you have a budget.

reset.rule: The pool refills on the 1st of each calendar month at 00:00 UTC.
stipulations: Credits are pooled across the organization, so heavy users draw from everyone's share.
Chat, Copilot CLI, cloud agent, Spaces, Spark, third-party agents and code review spend credits. Code completions and next edit suggestions don't.
Each model charges its own per-token API price. There are no multipliers and no free models.
Prices roughly double above the long-context threshold: 200K or 272K tokens, 100K for Claude Haiku 5.5.
Code review also uses GitHub Actions minutes.
A user-level budget is a hard stop that also caps included credits. A $0 user budget blocks that user at once.

overage: Additional usage is on by default for organizations and bills at the same per-token rates. Admins can turn it off with the AI credits paid usage policy, or set budgets per user, cost center, organization or enterprise. Users who run out see a banner to request more budget. Completions keep working even at a $0 budget.

how: $19 of AI Credits per seat a month, pooled across the organization and spent at each model's per-token API price.
Completions and next edit suggestions are unlimited and free.
ext: Claude, GPT, Gemini, Grok and Kimi models, subject to your admin's model policy. Claude Opus 4.8, Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4 nano aren't included.
Bring-your-own-key in VS Code: Anthropic, Gemini, OpenAI, OpenRouter, Azure, Ollama and Foundry Local. That usage bills to the key, not Copilot credits. Admins can turn it off.
Works in VS Code, Visual Studio, JetBrains, Xcode, Eclipse and Copilot CLI.
quirks: A Business seat cancels any personal Pro, Pro+ or Max plan, with a prorated refund.
Admins must enable Claude Fable 5.2, and it keeps data by default.
Business gets every Copilot Fusion tier (Standard, High and Max).

modelTable.title: GitHub Copilot: model prices per 1M tokens
modelTable.note: 1 AI Credit is $0.01. 1M output tokens on Claude Opus 5.5 costs 2,000 credits; on GPT-6 Luna it costs 50.
modelTable.footer: Anthropic models also charge for cache writes. Free and Student plans get auto model selection only.

events.what: Copilot Fusion 30% discount ends on paid plans. The docs say 30 Nov; the plans page banner says 31 Dec.
Gemini 4 Carbon price doubles to $4 in, $20 out per 1M tokens. Gemini 4 Argon promo price ends.
MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash promo prices end. Both then double.
